notes: Kölnbrein Dam’s 626 m double-curved arch, 70 m downstream reinforcement, mapped inspection cabins and the cantilevered steel-and-glass Airwalk. The 607.79 m mapped crest road controls the arch, with short tangential extensions into both shoulders to reach 626 m. Crest grade and the shape of the lower concrete sections are exterior approximations. The Airwalk plan follows the mapped ring and stair lines. The section, steel connections and depth of the glass deck are approximated from ordinary reference views. The terrain remains native at both shoulders and over the lower support. The full and sampled pool stages differ by 9.20 m, reflecting different water-level fixtures. No operating releases are modeled.
